title.narrative: Empowering civil society for a resilient equitable future

description.narrative: The Empowering Civil Society Organisations for a Resilient and Equitable Future project is a three-year initiative (October 2025 to December 2028) to be implemented in Mumbwa District, Zambia, targeting 2,000 beneficiaries (1,120 adult women, 480 young women, 200 young men, and 200 adult men). The project addresses persistent challenges faced by rural communities, including gender inequality, poverty, food insecurity, climate-related shocks, and limited access to essential services. These issues are further compounded by weak local governance and limited opportunities for women and youth to influence community decision-making processes. The project will strengthen the institutional capacity of the Mumbwa District Women Association (MDWA) and its 10 affiliated CBOs across ten area associations situated within the twelve agricultural camps. Interventions will focus on improving governance, leadership, enhanced advocacy, financial management, and accountability systems to position these organisations as inclusive and democratic drivers of community development. In parallel, the project will promote gender equality by increasing women's and youths' participation in leadership, preventing gender-based violence, and improving access to economic opportunities. Women and youth will be trained in climate-resilient agriculture, sustainable land management, and diversified livelihoods to enhance household resilience. By project completion, MDWA and its CBOs will operate more effectively, and communities will be better equipped to manage climate risks, achieve food security, and uphold the rights and dignity of women and youth.
